DK29.0 is a medical diagnosis code representing acute hemorrhagic gastritis (*akut blødende gastritis*) within the Danish healthcare classification system. In the context of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code plays a specific role in monitoring patient safety and treatment outcomes for [[atrieflimren]]. Specifically, DK29.0 is utilized as one of the diagnostic criteria to identify cases of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] (severe bleeding) among patients being treated for atrial fibrillation [^src1] [^src3].

To measure the incidence of severe bleeding—a critical quality indicator for patients on anticoagulant therapy—the AFDK methodology employs a comprehensive list of ICD-10-DK codes. DK29.0 is grouped within the gastrointestinal bleeding category, alongside other codes such as DK25.0–DK29.8A and DK92.0–DK92.2 [^src1]. This broad diagnostic net, which also includes codes for intracranial, urinary, and pulmonary bleeding, ensures that major bleeding events are systematically captured in national registry analyses to evaluate the safety of atrial fibrillation treatments across Danish regions [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].
